subject: Scheduling: Pricing & Dedicated Capacity workshop with Helix Medical
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly James <kimberly.james@helixmed.com>, Marcus Li <marcus.li@helixmed.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Pricing & Dedicated Capacity workshop — proposed times and agenda

Hi Kimberly / Marcus,

Thanks again for the discussion last week — great alignment on the workload profile. We'd like to schedule a focused 60-minute workshop to walk through:

- Quick recap of your expected monthly token volumes and peak concurrency (we reviewed the draft forecast attached)
- Dedicated capacity sizing options and estimated latencies/costs
- Pricing bands, commitment terms, and procurement process (PO/contract cadence)
- Security/network requirements and next steps for the SOC2/network questionnaire

Proposed 60-min slots (all ET):
- Tue Oct 13, 11:00–12:00
- Wed Oct 14, 14:00–15:00
- Thu Oct 15, 10:00–11:00

Attendees we suggest: Neha (AE), Dev (SE) to cover sizing + ops, Evelyn (Sales Manager) for contract/commitments. Please let me know who from your side will attend (CISO / procurement / eng). I attached the updated usage forecast and our pricing workbook to help the conversation.

Agenda (high level):
1) 10m — goal & current forecast
2) 25m — dedicated sizing & deployment modes (hosted vs dedicated vs private)
3) 15m — pricing/commitment options and draft workbook walk-through
4) 10m — next steps / procurement checklist / action items

If none of those slots work, tell me a couple of alternatives and we’ll adjust.

Thanks,
Neha
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0184

Attachments: helix_usage_forecast_v2.csv, redwood_pricing_workbook_v3.xlsx
From: Kimberly James <kimberly.james@helixmed.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Li <marcus.li@helixmed.com>, Asha Rao <asha.rao@helixmed.com>, eng-oncall@helixmed.com
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Pricing & Dedicated Capacity workshop — proposed times and agenda

Hi Neha,

Thanks — appreciate the clear agenda. We definitely want Dev on the call and will have procurement + our CISO join. Asha (CISO) will need to review the network/security section; Marcus (procurement) will want a hard TTL on the quote.

Quick notes:
- The 11am Tue slot conflicts with an exec review; Wed 14:00 ET looks best for our team.
- Please include our on-call engineering alias so we can pull runtime logs during the sizing discussion (eng-oncall@helixmed.com).
- I attached our filled security questionnaire (partial) for your pre-read — Asha will add more comments tomorrow.

If you can confirm Wed Oct 14, 14:00–15:00 ET and share a calendar invite + dial-in, we’ll lock it.

Best,
Kimberly
Kimberly James
Director of Clinical AI, Helix Medical
kimberly.james@helixmed.com
Attachment: helix_security_questionnaire.xlsx
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>

Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, eng-oncall@helixmed.com
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 12:08:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Pricing & Dedicated Capacity workshop — proposed times and agenda

Perfect — Wed Oct 14, 14:00–15:00 ET is confirmed on our side. Calendar invite to follow.

A couple of prep items to make the workshop productive:
- Dev: can you prepare a sizing sketch based on the Helix forecast and include a conservative burst profile?
- Kimberly / Asha: if you can highlight any network/IP allowlist constraints + retention requirements in the questionnaire that’ll help scope Private vs Hosted options.
- Marcus: to address the TTL ask, we typically hold the pricing workbook for 7 business days once a committed quote is issued; we can discuss extended holds for larger commits.

Proposed meeting invite text (will include docs & dial-in):
Agenda + links: short walkthrough of forecast -> dedicated sizing -> pricing workbook -> procurement checklist.

Thanks — sending the invite now.

Neha

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>

Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, eng-oncall@helixmed.com
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pricing & Dedicated Capacity workshop — proposed times and agenda

Hi all — I’ll take the sizing section. I’ll prepare:
- sizing sketch for 3 commitment tiers (baseline, 2x burst, 5x peak)
- expected p99/p50 latencies for the proposed hardware profile
- recommendations on prefix/KV caching to reduce token costs

Couple quick asks for Helix before the call: could you share a 48-hour sample of your live request distribution (anonymized is fine) or a histogram of hourly token counts? That’ll let me tune batch/instance counts more accurately.

I’ll upload the draft slides to the invite and keep it high level.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly James <kimberly.james@helixmed.com>, Marcus Li <marcus.li@helixmed.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Asha Rao <asha.rao@helixmed.com>, eng-oncall@helixmed.com
Date: Thu, 15 Oct 2026 09:44:00 -04:00
Subject: Schedule update — exec joining, slight time shift to accommodate

Hi Kimberly / Marcus / Asha,

Heads-up: our VP Engineering asked to join the workshop to run through the high-level deploy and SLA conversation. To accommodate their timing, would you be able to shift 14:00–15:00 ET to 14:30–15:30 ET on Wed Oct 14?

If 14:30–15:30 ET does not work for anyone on your side, we can keep the original hour but the VP will send a short intro note instead.

Also: Marcus, to make PoC -> committed capacity timelines clearer, can you confirm whether Helix requires a legal PO or a signed SOW for a capacity reservation? We’ll have a draft SOW ready to share during the workshop (attached).

Quick agenda note: we’ll plan for 75 minutes total if VP joins (45m sizing + 20m pricing + 10m procurement).

Thanks,
Neha
Attachments: redwood_pricing_workbook_v3.xlsx, SOW-draft-helix.docx
From: Marcus Li <marcus.li@helixmed.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Kimberly James <kimberly.james@helixmed.com>
Cc: Asha Rao <asha.rao@helixmed.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 Oct 2026 14:05:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Schedule update — exec joining, slight time shift to accommodate

Neha — 14:30–15:30 ET works for us. We’ll have procurement + legal on the line to confirm PO vs SOW requirements.

For the record: procurement prefers a PO for budgeted reserved capacity, but legal will sign SOWs for terms that change service levels. We’ll be ready to discuss both paths.

See you Wed.
Marcus
Marcus Li
Head of Procurement, Helix Medical
